3) Please confirm the correct payee name and bank details for wires (we have Redwood Inc and Redwood Inference listed in different places).

I've attached the signed SOW and PO (ACME_Final_SOW.pdf). We can provide the PO number once procurement confirms.

Hi Lisa — thanks for the SOW and the heads up. Looping in Karthik (finance) and Vanessa (CS ops) so we handle both the invoice format and the payment path cleanly.

Short answers up front:
- We can issue two line items on a single invoice (Subscription + Professional Services). If you prefer two separate invoices we can do that too — whichever matches your GL workflow.
- For US entities: Redwood does not typically withhold on customer payments. Withholding generally applies when a foreign entity provides services and the payer is required by local tax law to withhold. If ACME needs a withholding line, we need to confirm whether Redwood should accept a net payment (and we’ll provide a tax residency document) or whether ACME will gross-up.
- Payee and wire details: our legal payee is "Redwood Inference, Inc." — current bank wiring instructions are in the draft invoice I attached.

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik to confirm if Finance can accept net payments and provide a W-8/W-9 or residency certificate.
2) Vanessa to confirm the PO number and whether procurement prefers one invoice or two.
3) I’ll prepare a revised invoice and an amendment (if needed) and share the DocuSign link.

I attached a renewal invoice draft for you to review (renewal-invoice-draft.pdf). If you can flag the GL codes or the exact wording required for the withholding line, we’ll incorporate it.

Best,

Hi all — quick finance note from Redwood:

1) Net 30: fine on our side — we can accept Net 30 terms for this renewal.
2) Invoice structure: Redwood can either (A) issue two distinct invoices (one for subscription, one for professional services) with separate invoice numbers, or (B) one invoice with separate line items and GL mapping. If your ERP prefers two invoice numbers, we will deliver that.
3) Withholding: if ACME applies a withholding at payment, Redwood can accept a net payment and issue a tax residency/withholding acceptance letter. We do require a withholding certificate/confirmation from ACME's tax team showing the amount withheld (for our records and to reconcile the receivable). If ACME cannot provide the certificate, we will need to gross-up or route to escrow until confirmed.

Operational items: please confirm the exact remittance name to use on the invoice ("Redwood Inference, Inc.") and the PO number to reference (PO-4587). If you want two invoices, say so and we'll put separate invoice numbers and bank references.

I attached a sample two-invoice layout for internal clearance (invoice-2-tranche.pdf).

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
